title: Hypnotic Surrender
description:
Hypnotic Surrender | A Deep Trance Session With Goddess Amethyst

Surrender is something you do from within… and no one draws it out of you like I do.

My voice makes it easy to let go… easy to agree… easy to sink into that dreamy, quiet place where thoughts fade and only listening remains. You love being hypnotized, don’t you? Yesss… of course you do. And whether this is your first time with me or your hundredth, the drop is just as easy… as long as you follow my instructions and focus on the sound of my voice.

So get comfortable, close your eyes for me, and fall. Profound submission is the path… and every step along it feels easier than the last.

You’ll be back… because you love this now.

Subscribe to Goddess Amethyst for more deep trance sessions, and let my voice take you under again and again.
author: Mistress Amethyst
